items.title: Everpure Rebrands, Targets Broader Data Management - Let's Data Science
items.raw_summary: Pure Storage rebranded as Everpure in February 2026, dropping "Storage" from its name to signal a shift from storage infrastructure vendor to data management platform - coinciding with the acquisition of data intelligence firm 1touch and a record $1B earnings quarter. CEO Charlie Giancarlo told Forbes the old name "was actually holding us back" from executive conversations. The rebrand was refreshed at the PureAccelerate 2026 conference in June. For AI and ML teams, the story illustrates a recurring vendor pattern: storage players repositioning toward data governance and AI-readiness narratives to capture procurement budgets flowing to CDOs and AI leads.
